initialRun.failure: Firefox axe result serialization encountered a null node while API-isolation getter traps were installed. Editing/history checks passed in all engines.
initialRun.diagnosis: Controlled Firefox contexts passed without guards, passed with clipboard-only guard, failed with IndexedDB-only guard, then passed without guards. A combined-guard diagnostic failed with no observed DOM mutation or forbidden API access on the tested page. This establishes test-instrumentation interference, not its underlying engine/scanner cause.
initialRun.repair: Separate full API-isolation tests from an unmodified-page accessibility test. No axe rules disabled, retries added or deadlines increased. All 24 resulting tests passed. Initial exploratory diagnostic required an explicit browser context and was rerun with one.
